figurehead gets by on less food.

brings people comfort and peace with its

to have varied effects.

urging them on. His example inspires the crew.

Heaven's protection gives it a mysterious power
to ward off illness.

essential for finding your bearings at sea.
A navigation tool for pinpointing
your position at sea.

telescope, letting you see great distances.

looks like a living bloom frozen in place.
These marbles get their vivid colors from a
special process their makers keep secret.
Finely crushed gold, valuable even as dust.
Its beauty is quite unlike that of gold bars.
This stone mill grinds flour for bread dough.
It's an ideal gift for a hardworking woman.

refined upbringing. A Northern Song emperor, he
excelled at painting and calligraphy.
A beautiful woman is said to have come
from Heaven. She forgot this turban when she
went back.
A book on love and beauty by Sappho,
the ancient Greek poet.
A jar unearthed in a layer older than
pottery itself, fueling debate among scholars
of antiquity.

ancient Greek. It's considered a masterpiece
of its age.

Lovely colors capture its delicate beauty.

the Korean Peninsula. Remarkably ornate
for a piece from around the 7th century.
Earrings of small ceramic beads, beautifully
colored by mixing red and white materials.
A rare, large jade jewel, perfectly round and
said to glow white when light falls on it.
A classic Indian tale completed around
the fourth century, about a celestial maiden
and a sage who fall in love.

across the sea.

this Chinese tea bowl.

meticulously handwoven and embroidered
with a large sunflower.

prized for the color of its glaze.

2937: The king stands at the head of his troops, urging them on. His example inspires the crew.
Keep the king’s position and encouragement. End on the effect his example has on the crew.
2944: Finely crushed gold, valuable even as dust. Its beauty is quite unlike that of gold bars.
Preserve the value and compare the beauty of the two forms of gold in a complete second sentence.
2945: This stone mill grinds flour for bread dough. It's an ideal gift for a hardworking woman.
Keep the purpose of the mill and the source’s specific gift description in two sentences.
2946: Huizong's graceful watercolor shows his refined upbringing. A Northern Song emperor, he excelled at painting and calligraphy.
Restore the two arts and imperial title and preserve the source’s attribution of the painting’s grace to his upbringing.
2947: A beautiful woman is said to have come from Heaven. She forgot this turban when she went back.
Keep her descent, her return and the accidental loss, all within the legend.
2952: Gold crown from Silla, first state to unite the Korean Peninsula. Remarkably ornate for a piece from around the 7th century.
Keep the full geographic reference, the approximate date and the source’s appraisal of the artistry.
